Something is going on at the school, but I don't know what.
“The job doesn't pay very well and the hours are long.” “I think you should look for something better.”

Is there something [=anything] wrong?
Is there something [=anything] good on TV tonight?

I got you a little something [=a small thing] for your birthday. 我刚想说点什么，但她打断了我。
我有事情要告诉你。

我不知道她学什么，但好像和电脑有关。

有什么问题吗？

“他们不会多给我们一周时间完成，但会多给我们几天。”“那也算不错了。”
你晚餐想吃披萨还是别的什么？
我给你买了点小礼物，祝你生日快乐。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k c0378a7e-489f-48db-8982-bc85f2759cfc 0792db9f-e4d4-484f-8d16-f861e3097bb8 really adverb ˈriːjəli https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/r/really01.wav used to refer to what is true or real 用来指代真实或实际的事物 She didn't really mean it. 她并不是真的那个意思。 Is that really a word? 那真的是一个词吗？ It turned out that the bone wasn't really broken. 结果发现骨头其实并没有断。 He might really be the one she's going to marry.
They really are twins.
What really happened?
There are really only two choices.
Who really cares?
I'm not hurt—really. [=I am being honest when I say I'm not hurt]
Did you really [=honestly] think I wouldn't notice? 他可能真的就是她要嫁的人。
他们真的就是双胞胎。
到底发生了什么？
实际上只有两个选择。
谁真的在乎呢？
我真的没受伤。
你真的以为我不会注意到吗？ eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

without question or doubt 毫无疑问，毫不怀疑 You should really see a doctor about your back pains. 你真的应该去看医生，检查一下你的背部疼痛。 I really believe she's not coming back. 我真的相信她不会回来了。 You really should try some of this cake. 你真的应该尝尝这块蛋糕。 She really is a nice person.
We really need the extra money.
He really likes her. [=he likes her very much] 她真的是个很好的人。
我们真的很需要这笔额外的钱。
他真的很喜欢她。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

a really frightening/funny story
I had a really good time at the party. 今天真的很美好。
一个非常吓人/有趣的故事
我在聚会上玩得非常开心。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

Who does he think he is?” “他不应该被允许那样做。” “是啊，真的。他以为他是谁？” eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k c42b68b9-4ac8-4178-bf62-fbd6255f610a f339ab81-3129-4d69-a216-73acf68747e7 most adverb ˈmoʊst https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/m/most0001.wav in or to the greatest degree 在最大程度上 Of all the gifts he received that day, the book pleased him most. 在那天他收到的所有礼物中，这本书最让他高兴。 What matters most to you? 对你来说，最重要的是什么？ The island is the most southern in the chain. 该岛是该群岛中最南端的一个。 You'll benefit most from the exercises if you do them every day.
most active/important
most actively/importantly

the most beautiful woman there

the most common/popular kind
The report shows the intersections at which accidents are most likely to occur.
the most widely used treatment 如果你每天都做这些练习，你会受益最大。
最活跃/最重要
最积极地/最重要地
这是她做过的最有挑战性的工作。

最常见/最受欢迎的种类
报告显示最有可能发生事故的路口。
最广泛使用的治疗方法 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 206fd5ef-7843-415e-a37f-89b5926ef197 f339ab81-3129-4d69-a216-73acf68747e7 most adverb ˈmoʊst https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/m/most0001.wav somewhat formal to a great extent very 在很大程度上，非常 He is a most careful driver. 他是一个非常小心的司机。 Their argument was most persuasive. 他们的论点极具说服力。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

very nearly almost 非常接近，几乎，差不多 The cost of most everything is higher. 大多数东西的成本都更高了。 Most anyone can go. 几乎任何人都可以去。 most everywhere in the country 几乎在全国各地 We'll be arriving most any time now.
They most always skip lunch. 我们很快就要到了。
他们几乎总是跳过午餐。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

As far as I'm concerned, “frugal” is just another word for “cheap.” [=“frugal” means the same thing as “cheap”]
We had dinner at another one of the city's many Italian restaurants.
This is yet another example of government waste.
If you ask me, he's just another overpaid athlete. [=he's one of many overpaid athletes] 那只是换一种说法表达同样的意思。
就我而言，“节俭”只是“吝啬”的另一种说法。
我们在这座城市众多意大利餐厅中的另一家吃了晚餐。
这又是一个政府浪费的例子。
如果你问我，他只是又一个薪水过高的运动员。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

This one is chipped.
Since his illness he has been another man. [=he has been very different from how he was before he became sick]
Tomorrow is another day.
the splendors of another age [=a past age]
I'm willing to help you, but if you're asking for money, that's another thing/matter/story. [=I'm willing to help you but that does not mean that I'm willing to give you money]
Complaining about problems is one thing, but finding solutions to them is another thing altogether/entirely. [=it is more difficult to find solutions to problems than to complain about them] 请再给我拿一个杯子。这个杯子有缺口。
自从生病后，他变了一个人。
明天又是新的一天。
另一个时代的辉煌
我愿意帮你，但如果你是要钱，那就是另一回事了。
抱怨问题是一回事，找到解决办法则完全是另一回事。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

[=as a person who was like Napoleon] 他把自己看作另一个拿破仑。 The city advertises itself as another Las Vegas. 这座城市把自己宣传为另一个拉斯维加斯。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

This cup is chipped. Could you please bring me another? 一个小偷带着枪，另一个（带着）刀。
这个杯子有缺口。请你再给我拿一个吗？ eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

[=in another person's house] 她不习惯住在别人的房子里。 Complaining about problems is one thing, but finding solutions to them is another. [=it is more difficult to find solutions to problems than to complain about them] 抱怨问题是一回事，但找到解决问题的方法则是另一回事。 The family seems to move from one city to another. 这个家庭似乎从一个城市搬到另一个城市。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

They had to change their plans for one/some reason or another. [=for some reason] 他发誓无论如何都要成功。
他们不得不因为某种原因改变了计划。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

[=a lot of effort] 解决这个问题将需要大量的努力。 The project is taking too much time. [=is taking more time than it should] 这个项目花费的时间太长了。 I can't believe that we spent so much money. [=such a large amount of money]
How much money do you have?
Was there much food at the party?
He doesn't know much French.

There isn't much difference between them.
The clerk wasn't much help. [=was not very helpful]
